title: the Areopagite
name: Dionysius
troparia: (Tone 4) You learned goodness and practiced temperance.* You robed yourself in the priesthood* and girded yourself with a good conscience.* Therefore, you came to draw ineffable things from the chosen vessel, Paul.* You have completed the race, you have kept the faith.* O father Dionysius, beg Christ our God to save our souls.
kontakia: (Tone 8) In a spiritual way you passed through the gates of heaven,* and you climbed to the third heaven with the apostle Paul.* You were given a deep understanding of mystical things* with which you have given light to the ignorant.* For all this we invoke you, O Dionysius:* Rejoice, O father of all!
